name: OpenBookQA
description: OpenBookQA is a question-answering dataset modeled after open book exams for assessing human understanding. It contains 5,957 multiple-choice elementary-level science questions that probe understanding of 1,326 core science facts and their application to novel situations, requiring combination of open book facts with broad common knowledge through multi-hop reasoning.
reputation: Published at EMNLP 2018; standard commonsense science reasoning benchmark; requires combining science facts with general knowledge; now largely saturated by frontier models
notes: Published at EMNLP 2018. Contains 5,957 multiple-choice questions across train/dev/test splits with 4 answer choices each. Questions are paired with one of 1,326 core science facts but require additional commonsense or world knowledge to answer — not solvable by fact retrieval alone. Human performance ~92%. Now largely saturated.
